listing.name: Diablo II: Resurrected — Reign of the Warlock (d2r-mobile)
listing.summary: Build this Diablo II: Resurrected port from your own Switch game and Reign of the Warlock expansion 1.0.34.0. The project has Apple silicon Mac, iOS and Android routes. Mobile downloads still need your game files and a locally prepared runtime.
listing.original_game_title: Diablo II: Resurrected — Reign of the Warlock

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Use the matching expansion build 1.0.34.0 (PC 3.3.94012), ExeFS, RomFS and your own prod.keys for extraction. Other build IDs are unconfirmed.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Use setup.sh to prepare modules and shaders. On Mac, mac_app.sh builds the app and DM_MAC_M3 selects the older API. The iOS shell ZIP and Android shell files need your own prepared data. Rebuild when updating.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The guide covers Apple silicon macOS 26 or later or an older API on 15–25, iOS 26 or an older API on 18–25, and Android ARM64 API 31+ with Vulkan 1.1. The early Mac has keyboard and gamepad limits. HarmonyOS is community-supported and tvOS has reached character selection only.
